trialSource.patchPolicy: Task 3 records every spike patch that exists as a patch in ../.uniwork-dev/office-g0/patches/ (numbered .patch plus checksum) and registers it in trialSource.patchBundle. At the pinned commit the spike produced exactly one patch-shaped artifact (the lab pageImagePng extension, already integrated into the phase root) plus one transformer script; no trial-source (genoffice) patch exists, so trialSource.patches stays empty. entries.integrationStatus: host-adapter.mjs is already integrated in the phase root (canonical SHA-256 equals this postimage); lab-server.mjs has moved on to contract revision C, so this entry replays on its documented preimage only and must not be re-applied to the current phase root.

notRegistered.why: the spike delivered it as a transformer script (patch-slides-edit-transform.mjs + anchor-based self-test) with preimage/postimage hashes for the revision-B lab base only, not as a .patch file; registering it as a patch would misstate what replays

the spike ran the unmodified pinned tree: no packages/*-engine/src or apps/* patch exists at the pinned commit, so the trial source needs no patch and trialSource.patches stays empty; the replay path is exercised by entry 0001 instead

portabilityFacts: git apply must run with core.autocrlf=false and core.eol=lf, or the replay re-emits host line endings and the postimage hash never matches
the clean root must be a git work tree: outside one, git apply silently skips rename-shaped entries and still exits 0
